Phishing Guard.description: Analyzes URLs and SMS messages for scam indicators using Google Safe Browsing and AI analysis.
Phishing Guard.how_to_use: Go to the Phishing Guard tab, paste a URL or text message, and click Scan.

Cyber Assist.description: Provides immediate guidance for cyber incidents like UPI fraud, Identity theft, or Social Media hacking.
Cyber Assist.how_to_use: Select the type of incident in the Cyber Assist tab to get a step-by-step action plan.

App Sentinel.description: Scans files (APK, EXE, PDF) for malware signatures using VirusTotal.
App Sentinel.how_to_use: Upload a file in the App Sentinel tab to check if it's malicious.

Voice Shield.description: Helps identify spam callers and potential voice deepfakes (simulation mode).
Voice Shield.how_to_use: Enter a phone number to check its reputation score.

Secure Vault.description: A secure, encrypted storage for passwords and sensitive notes.
Secure Vault.how_to_use: Use the Secure Vault tab to add or retrieve encrypted items.

QR Analyzer.description: Decodes QR codes and checks the embedded links for safety before you open them.
QR Analyzer.how_to_use: Upload a QR code image to analyze its content safety.

general_advice: Never share your OTP or UPI PIN with anyone.
Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) on all accounts.
Do not click on links from unknown numbers.
Verify caller identity before transferring money.
